title: Product Review - 12 October 2026
summary: The team reviewed beta feedback and identified slow search as the main issue. They decided to add caching instead of changing the search engine and set a review deadline of 20 October. A help article for the export feature will be drafted in November, and the dark mode bug will be fixed by Friday. The discussion on a student discount was postponed to the next review.
discussion_points: Users reported slow search performance, about three seconds on large accounts.
Options to address search speed included adding caching or switching search engines.
Support received many questions about the export feature and needs a help article.
Consideration of a student discount for pricing.
Ownership of the dark mode bug was clarified.
decisions: Do not switch search engines at this time.
Add caching to improve search performance.
Defer writing the export feature help article until November.

action_items.task: Add caching and have it ready for review
Draft help article for the export feature

open_questions: Should a student discount be offered?
